# oneuptime_dashboard_label_rule (Resource)

Dashboard label rule resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oneuptime_dashboard_label_rule" "example" {
  name = "Example short text"
}
```

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the resource. Computed.
